episodes.title: He That Hath an Ear
episodes.summary: Believing he miraculously delivered Damascus from ruin, a throng follows a man they call al-Masih into the desert, raising suspicions in the CIA.

episodes.title: Tremor
episodes.summary: In Israel, tensions rise while CIA officer Eva seeks answers, and dramatic footage of al-Masih goes viral. In Texas, a desperate pastor forms a plan.

episodes.title: The Finger of God
episodes.summary: Appearing inexplicably during a Texas tornado, al-Masih quietly moves pastor Felix to embrace a new purpose. But Eva -- and the FBI -- quickly close in.

episodes.title: Trial
episodes.summary: Coping with grief, Eva questions al-Masih, but his riveting charisma turns the tables. A deportation trial becomes a political lightning rod.

episodes.title: So That Seeing They May Not See
episodes.summary: While Eva keeps close watch on al-Masih, Felix wrestles with what to believe as his church becomes a magnet for the devout and the desperate.

episodes.title: We Will Not All Sleep
episodes.summary: Jibril has a striking vision in the desert. Eva finally gets hard intel on al-Masih, whose devotees form a convoy to follow him out of Texas.

episodes.title: It Came to Pass as It Was Spoken
episodes.summary: News of a marvel electrifies the phenomenon around al-Masih, but Eva's skepticism deepens. Jibril's and Samer's paths diverge amid political unrest.

episodes.title: Force Majeure
episodes.summary: Gaining the ear of the president, al-Masih issues a challenge and causes turmoil in the White House. But he soon faces probing questions himself.

episodes.title: God Is Greater
episodes.summary: Eva unearths alarming details about al-Masih's past. Jibril's and Samer's paths unexpectedly collide. Rebecca steps up at a crucial moment.

episodes.title: The Wages of Sin
episodes.summary: Eva scrambles to thwart a plan designed to silence al-Masih, while breaking news causes dismay among his followers.
